On the [March 30 episode](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/5-stocks-buy-before-q2-heats-up-2) of _The Morning Filter_ podcast, we recommended that it was time to start harvesting profits in the value category, specifically energy stocks, and reallocate those proceeds into the growth category, specifically into technology and AI stocks. The consumer cyclical sector also posted a double-digit gain in April, yet almost the entire return was driven by Amazon.com [AMZN](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/xnas/amzn/quote), which started the month as a 4-star-rated stock. While the technology sector contains some of the most undervalued mega-cap stocks tied to artificial intelligence, such as Nvidia and Broadcom, it also contains some of the stocks we think are most overvalued in today’s market, such as Ciena [CIEN](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/xnys/cien/quote) and Western Digital [WDC](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/xnas/wdc/quote).
